stories.title_en: The ‘Luxury’ Water Rat Race Isn’t as Inexplicable as It Seems
stories.desc_en: From Loonen to Supergoop founder Holly Thaggard’s newest venture, a cohort of clean and benefit-infused challenger water brands is rising. Category data shows the timing might be just right.
stories.desc_zh: 从Loonen到Supergoop创始人Holly Thaggard的最新合资企业，一批干净利润丰厚的挑战者水品牌正在崛起。类别数据显示时机可能恰到好处。

stories.title_en: EXCLUSIVE: Alix Earle Invests in Cymbiotika
stories.desc_en: The infusion comes on the heels of several retail expansions and a separate, $26 million raise earlier this year for the supplement brand.
stories.desc_zh: 此次注入是在今年早些时候几次零售扩张以及单独为补充剂品牌筹集2600万美元$之后进行的。

stories.title_en: How Beauty Performed During the First Half of 2026
stories.desc_en: Circana data shows that online overtook brick-and-mortar as the top channel for prestige skin care, while  shifts are afoot in mass makeup.
stories.desc_zh: Circana数据显示，在线已超越实体店，成为声望护肤的顶级渠道，而大规模化妆正在发生变化。

stories.title_en: Beauty Historian Erin Parsons Launches the Makeup Archive She Always Dreamed Of
stories.desc_en: The online museum displays and details more than 1,500 rare beauty products Parsons has collected over the years — including vintage Richard Hudnut, Marilyn Monroe's lipsticks and more.
stories.desc_zh: 这个在线博物馆展示并详细介绍了帕森斯多年来收集的1,500多种稀有美容产品，包括复古Richard Hudnut、Marilyn Monroe的口红等。

stories.title_en: EXCLUSIVE: Pat McGrath, Nicolas Ghesquière Team for Louis Vuitton’s First Beauty Collaboration
stories.desc_en: It marks the first time Louis Vuitton La Beauté product packaging features the house’s Monogram canvas.
stories.desc_zh: 这标志着Louis Vuitton La Beauté产品包装首次采用品牌的Monogram帆布。

stories.title_en: EXCLUSIVE: Jo Malone London Gets Playful, Launching Latest Fragrance With Fortnite Game
stories.desc_en: Jo Malone London will unveil its first gaming activation to mark the global launch of Sea Salt & Bergamot cologne.
stories.desc_zh: Jo Malone London将推出其首款游戏激活，以纪念Sea Salt & Bergamot古龙水的全球推出。

stories.title_en: EXCLUSIVE: Saie Enters the Eye Shadow Category
stories.desc_en: Inspired by 1990s minimalism, the new SuperSuede Bake collection campaign is fronted by Danish supermodel Helena Christensen.
stories.desc_zh: 受到20世纪90年代极简主义的启发，新的SuperSuede Bake系列活动由丹麦超模海伦娜·克里斯滕森（ Helena Christensen ）主导。

stories.title_en: Amina Mohamed’s Skin Deep Is Making the Case for Beauty Literacy
stories.desc_en: After a decade in luxury communications at Farfetch and Chalhoub Group, Amina Mohamed is betting that what beauty consumers really want isn’t just more product. It’s more understanding.
stories.desc_zh: 在Farfetch和Chalhoub集团从事奢侈品传播工作十年后， Amina Mohamed押注美容消费者真正想要的不仅仅是更多的产品。这是更多的理解。

stories.title_en: EXCLUSIVE: Cocokind Founder Priscilla Tsai and Beauty Creator Ava Lee Launch Mimitime at Target
stories.desc_en: The collagen-infused konjac jelly brand will debut with four flavors.
stories.desc_zh: 注入胶原蛋白的魔芋果冻品牌将首次推出四种口味。

stories.title_en: Wells Fargo Names Anthony Giuliano Head of Beauty and Wellness
stories.desc_en: Giuliano has advised companies including Estée Lauder, Procter & Gamble, and L’Oréal.
stories.desc_zh: Giuliano曾为雅诗兰黛、宝洁和欧莱雅等公司提供咨询服务。

stories.title_en: CeraVe’s game plan to become a leading dermocosmetics sun care brand
stories.desc_en: The L’Oréal-owned drugstore brand, which recently launched its first sun protection range, is on a mission to become a top five dermocosmetics sun protection brand globally. But can the ceramide skin care player dominate in the sun care space?
stories.desc_zh: 欧莱雅旗下的药店品牌最近推出了首个防晒系列，其使命是成为全球五大皮肤化妆品防晒品牌。但神经酰胺护肤品能在防晒领域占据主导地位吗？

stories.title_en: Jo Malone London debuts first gaming collaboration with Fortnite to promote Sea Salt & Bergamot
stories.desc_en: The Estée Lauder Companies-owned fragrance brand is bringing its newly launched Sea Salt & Bergamot collection , inspired by the wild waters of the British coast, to new audiences via a new partnership with Epic Games’ ‘Battle Royal’ shooter game
stories.desc_zh: 雅诗兰黛公司旗下的香水品牌通过与Epic Games的“Battle Royal”射击游戏建立新的合作伙伴关系，将受英国海岸野生水域启发的新推出海盐和佛手柑系列带给新的观众

stories.title_en: Kenvue sales near $4 billion despite tariff and inflation pressures in Q2 2026
stories.desc_en: Although tariffs, inflation and currency-related costs led Kenvue to fall short of its Q2 estimates, the company’s beauty division delivered strong growth for the consumer health group
stories.desc_zh: 尽管关税、通货膨胀和货币相关成本导致Kenvue低于其第二季度的预期，但该公司的美容部门为消费者健康集团带来了强劲的增长

stories.title_en: PZ Cussons reports 5.4% revenue increase as Africa strategic review delivers
stories.desc_en: PZ Cussons, the owner of beauty companies Sanctuary Spa, Imperial Leather and St. Tropez, has reported strong growth in Africa in FY26 following the completion of a strategic review of the market
stories.desc_zh: 美容公司Sanctuary Spa、Imperial Leather和St. Tropez的所有者PZ Cussons报告称，在完成市场战略审查后， 26财年在非洲实现了强劲增长

stories.title_en: M.ph beauty names ​Kira Jackson as Chief Marketing Officer
stories.desc_en: Make-up brand m.ph beauty, founded by celebrity MUA Mary Phillips, has tapped former consumer brand investor Kira Jackson to lead its marketing
stories.desc_zh: 由名人MUA Mary Phillips创立的化妆品牌m.ph beauty已聘请前消费品牌投资人Kira Jackson领导其营销

stories.title_en: 2026’s biggest beauty reformulations: from Estée Lauder and Charlotte Tilbury to SkinCeuticals
stories.desc_en: Iconic products and cult formulas are being reinvented in 2026, including Estée Lauder’s Double Wear foundation, Charlotte Tilbury’s Magic Cream, Bobbi Brown Cosmetics’ Face Base and SkinCeuticals’ C E Ferulic. Cosmetics Business takes a look as to why
stories.desc_zh: 2026年，雅诗兰黛的Double Wear粉底、夏洛特·蒂尔伯里的Magic Cream、Bobbi Brown Cosmetics的Face Base和SkinCeuticals的C E Ferulic等标志性产品和流行配方将被重新发明。化妆品业务部门了解原因

stories.title_en: Selena Gomez’s Rare Beauty unveils second eau de parfum Rare Beginnings
stories.desc_en: Fruity-floral eau de parfum Rare Beginnings has been launched to ramp up the beauty brand’s fragrance offering, following the success of Gomez’s first scent, Rare, in July 2025. It is available exclusively at Sephora
stories.desc_zh: 继Gomez于2025年7月成功推出第一款香水Rare之后， Fruity-floral淡香精Rare Beginnings已经推出，以加强该美容品牌的香水产品。它仅在丝芙兰独家提供

stories.title_en: How membrane emulsification can help ease regulatory pressures in cosmetics in 2027 and beyond
stories.desc_en: Micropore Technologies’ Dave Palmer explains how membrane emulsification can help ease the pathway to regulatory compliance for brands and manufacturers, while protecting margins
stories.desc_zh: Micropore Technologies的Dave Palmer解释了膜乳化如何帮助品牌和制造商简化合规途径，同时保护利润

stories.title_en: MAC Cosmetics pays homage to artist Jean-Michel Basquiat with new collection
stories.desc_en: The Estée Lauder Companies-owned make-up brand’s new six-strong collection pays homage to the New York artist’s legacy and has been launched ahead of an upcoming Netflix documentary, Jean-Michel
stories.desc_zh: 雅诗兰黛公司旗下的化妆品牌全新六强系列向这位纽约艺术家的遗产致敬，并在即将上映的Netflix纪录片《让-米歇尔》（ Jean-Michel ）之前推出

stories.title_en: Hypochlorous acid sprays are in demand – here are 7 of the best new launches
stories.desc_en: As hypochlorous acid continues its transition from clinical to consumer-focused, uncover why the skin care ingredient is stepping into the spotlight, and the best spray launches infused with it to land so far
stories.desc_zh: 随着次氯酸继续从临床过渡到以消费者为中心，揭示为什么护肤成分正在成为人们关注的焦点，以及迄今为止最好的喷雾剂

stories.title_en: Henkel raises full-year guidance on ‘strong’ H1 2026, despite softer consumer brands performance
stories.desc_en: The German personal care company’s recent acquisition of hair care brands Olaplex and Not Your Mother’s has contributed to a 3.2% rise in organic sales in the first half of 2026
stories.desc_zh: 这家德国个人护理公司最近收购了头发护理品牌Olaplex和Not Your Mother's ，使2026年上半年的有机销售额增长了3.2%

stories.title_en: Rare Beauty Brands opens accelerator programme for underrepresented beauty brand founders
stories.desc_en: Funding, mentorship and retail opportunities with JCPenney will be offered to three founders with early-stage brands, through the Kate Somerville and Patchology-owner’s LIFT Beauty Accelerator
stories.desc_zh: JCPenney将通过Kate Somerville和Patchology所有者的LIFT Beauty Accelerator向三位拥有早期品牌的创始人提供资金、指导和零售机会

stories.title_en: Shiseido’s profits surge 90% as turnaround plan takes shape
stories.desc_en: Improvement in the NARS Cosmetics and Cle de Peau de Beauté owner’s performance in the Americas has helped boost profit, while fragrance was also a standout performer for the Japanese beauty giant in Q2
stories.desc_zh: NARS化妆品和Cle de Peau de Beauté所有者在美洲的业绩改善有助于提高利润，而香水也是这家日本美容巨头在第二季度的突出表现

stories.title_en: Curtis Packaging secures the victory for the Best Secondary Packaging Innovation in the Cosmetics Business Innovation Awards
stories.desc_en: Judge Nick Vaus praised the originality, usability and commercial impact of the innovation, recognising its potential to influence the future of decorative secondary packaging.
stories.desc_zh: Nick Vaus法官赞扬了这项创新的独创性、可用性和商业影响力，并认识到其影响装饰性二级包装未来的潜力。

stories.title_en: Haut.AI launches AI clinical studies software as beauty R&D pushes for larger, faster skin trials
stories.desc_en: Haut.AI launches its Clinical Studies Software, a validated platform that measures 48 face, body and hair biomarkers and enables skincare, ingredient and dermatology companies to run remote and hybrid skin studies across cohorts of hundreds to thousands
stories.desc_zh: Haut.AI推出其临床研究软件，这是一个经过验证的平台，可测量48种面部、身体和头发生物标志物，使护肤、成分和皮肤科公司能够在数百至数千人中进行远程和混合皮肤研究

stories.title_en: Beauty Briefing: From tampons to fragrance, K-beauty is everywhere
stories.desc_en: This week, Glossy checked in on K-beauty’s growth beyond traditional beauty categories like makeup and skin care, into everything from menstrual products to “scent care.” Additionally, Katie Jane Hughes’ makeup brand gears up for its Sephora debut, and Amouage reports yet more sales growth.
stories.desc_zh: 本周， Glossy检查了K-beauty在传统美容类别（如化妆品和护肤品）之外的增长，从月经产品到“气味护理”。“此外， Katie Jane Hughes的化妆品品牌为Sephora的首次亮相做好了准备， Amouage报告了更多的销售增长。

stories.title_en: Exclusive: Jupiter enters Ulta Beauty as the retailer targets dandruff, solution-based hair care
stories.desc_en: Jupiter, the 6-year-old dandruff category disruptor, is entering 500 Ulta Beauty stores this month as the retailer pushes deeper into clinical- and solution-based hair care.
stories.desc_zh: 6岁的头皮屑类别破坏者Jupiter本月将进入500家Ulta Beauty商店，因为这家零售商更深入地推进基于临床和解决方案的头发护理。

stories.title_en: Ulta Beauty bets on the growing scalp-care market with prestige hair-care brand Nutrire
stories.desc_en: Ulta Beauty is known for its budget-friendly beauty products. But the beauty giant is betting its consumers will trade up for $68 scalp serums with the launch of Chicago-based hair-care brand Nutrire.
stories.desc_zh: Ulta Beauty以其经济实惠的美容产品而闻名。但这家美容巨头押注，随着总部位于芝加哥的头发护理品牌Nutrire的推出，其消费者将以68 $的头皮精华液进行交易。

stories.title_en: How awards show beauty partnerships between artists, brands and celebs come together, with PRTNRS’ Marissa Alfe and Lauren FitzGerald
stories.desc_en: Have you ever wondered how awards show beauty partnerships come together to create big, splashy red carpet moments that seem to reverberate across social media for weeks or months? In today's episode of the Glossy Beauty Podcast, industry agents Marissa Alfe and Lauren FitzGerald break it down.
stories.desc_zh: 您是否曾经想过，奖项展示美容合作伙伴关系如何聚集在一起，创造出大而引人注目的红地毯时刻，这些时刻似乎会在社交媒体上回荡数周或数月？在今天的Glossy Beauty播客中，行业代理商Marissa Alfe和Lauren FitzGerald对其进行了细分。

stories.title_en: Rhode sells $27 million DTC in one day, plots 19 country expansion
stories.desc_en: Hailey Bieber's Rhode continues to be the beauty industry’s star performer.
stories.desc_zh: 海莉·比伯（ Hailey Bieber ）的罗德（ Rhode ）仍然是美容行业的明星。

stories.title_en: Your favorite beauty brands are now also entertainment brands
stories.desc_en: Advertising has long existed alongside entertainment, either in the form of TV ad breaks or product placement. But as today’s consumers are up to their eyeballs in entertaining content just a scroll and a click away, many of today’s beauty brands are asking if entertainment and advertising can be one and the same.
stories.desc_zh: 广告长期以来一直与娱乐并存，无论是以电视广告休息还是产品展示的形式。但是，由于当今的消费者只需滚动和点击鼠标即可观看娱乐内容，因此当今的许多美容品牌都在询问娱乐和广告是否可以是一回事。

stories.title_en: Wellness Briefing: A new class of oral care disruptors hopes to shake up the space with novel offerings, plus news
stories.desc_en: For the Wellness Briefing, Glossy spoke with founders of recently launched oral-care brands looking to disrupt the space, including Köppen, Evenmouth and Bastét, which offer products based on a three-step system, microbiome-focused protocol and novel ingredients, respectively.
stories.desc_zh: 在健康简报会上， Glossy与最近推出的口腔护理品牌的创始人进行了交谈，这些品牌希望颠覆这一领域，包括Köppen、Evenmouth和Bastét ，它们分别提供基于三步系统的产品、以微生物组为重点的方案和新成分。

stories.title_en: Beauty Briefing: Why legacy brands are doubling down on hero products
stories.desc_en: This week, I checked in on the wave of revamped and relaunched hero products from heritage beauty brands. Additionally, Saltair gets new ownership, and Victoria Beckham’s 15-year-old daughter is rumored to be launching a beauty brand.
stories.desc_zh: 本周，我查看了来自传统美容品牌的改良和重新推出的英雄产品的浪潮。此外， Saltair获得了新的所有权，据传维多利亚·贝克汉姆（ Victoria Beckham ） 15岁的女儿将推出一个美容品牌。

stories.title_en: Retail’s new operating model centers on leaner teams, smarter data and physical community
stories.desc_en: The conversation around AI has moved well beyond experimentation. At the recent Glossy & Modern Retail Brand Leaders Dinner, with partner Global Payments, founders and executives shared how they're using artificial intelligence to automate operations, rethink hiring, build internal knowledge platforms and refine marketing strategies. But despite the rapid adoption, attendees agreed that the businesses best positioned to win will still be those that invest in community, physical retail and ex
stories.desc_zh: 围绕人工智能的对话已经远远超出了实验的范畴。在最近的Glossy & Modern零售品牌领导者晚宴上，创始人和高管与合作伙伴Global Payments分享了他们如何利用人工智能实现运营自动化、重新思考招聘、构建内部知识平台和完善营销策略。但是，尽管迅速采用，与会者一致认为，最有能力获胜的企业仍然是那些投资于社区、实体零售和

stories.title_en: Well-funded innovators rush to define and lead the emerging ‘hair longevity’ category
stories.desc_en: Led by a handful of industry innovators with deep pockets for advanced R&D, the hair-care space is on the brink of a philosophical shift around how consumers should care for their hair.
stories.desc_zh: 在少数拥有雄厚研发资金的行业创新者的带领下，头发护理领域正处于消费者应该如何护理头发的哲学转变的边缘。

stories.title_en: Glossy Pop Newsletter: How 16-year-old Embreigh Courtlyn turned her friend group into a $2.2 million Target launch
stories.desc_en: Target’s latest creator-led fashion bet is on a 16-year-old Alabama creator, her highly invested young fan base and a friend group whose trips, fallouts and reunions are followed like an ongoing TikTok reality show.
stories.desc_zh: Target最新的创作者主导的时尚投注对象是一位16岁的阿拉巴马州创作者、她高度投入的年轻粉丝群和一个朋友团体，他们的旅行、余波和团聚就像正在进行的TikTok真人秀节目一样受到关注。

stories.title_en: How Ulta Beauty is reaching Gen Zalpha teen boys through first men’s masstige fragrance launch
stories.desc_en: Teen boys have become an increasingly important consumer demographic over the past few years thanks to their insatiable appetite for fragrance. Now, Ulta Beauty is aspiring to capture their attention with its first masstige fragrance launch. Glossy reporters Zofia Zwieglinska and Emily Jensen join Glossy Beauty Podcast host Lexy Lebsack to unpack the rise of the Gen Zalpha fraghead and how Ulta Beauty is hoping to woo them.
stories.desc_zh: 在过去几年中，由于青少年对香水的贪得无厌，他们已成为越来越重要的消费群体。现在， Ulta Beauty渴望通过其首款masstige香水来吸引他们的注意力。Glossy记者Zofia Zwieglinska和Emily Jensen加入Glossy Beauty播客主持人Lexy Lebsack ，解开Zalpha世代的崛起，以及Ulta Beauty希望如何向他们求爱。

stories.title_en: Laura Mercier is replacing traditional influencers with tastemaker-consultants
stories.desc_en: With the launch of its new collective, Laura Mercier is adapting to a social media environment where consumers have grown skeptical of traditional influencer marketing, and micro-influencers and niche tastemakers reign supreme.
stories.desc_zh: 随着新集体的推出， Laura Mercier正在适应社交媒体环境，在这种环境中，消费者对传统网红营销越来越持怀疑态度，而微型网红和利基时尚制造者占据主导地位。

stories.title_en: Wellness Briefing: The peptide pipeline gets new legal momentum, plus news
stories.desc_en: For the Wellness Briefing, Glossy checked in with leaders in the peptide space, including attorney Jeff Cohen, Nuritas founder Dr. Nora Khaldi and CeliaRx founder Koehl Robinson, to unpack the results of last week’s FDA advisory committee meetings. Additionally, Whoop hires Glossier's former CEO as its chief commercial officer, the AI-powered robotic massage market grows, and skin-care brand Prequel expands its executive team.
stories.desc_zh: 在健康简报会上， Glossy与多肽领域的领导者进行了沟通，包括律师Jeff Cohen、Nuritas创始人Nora Khaldi博士和CeliaRx创始人Koehl Robinson ，以公布上周FDA咨询委员会会议的结果。此外， Whoop聘请Glossier的前首席执行官担任首席商务官，人工智能机器人按摩市场不断发展，护肤品牌Prequel扩大了其执行团队。

stories.title_en: Peach & Lily brings ‘zombie cell’ innovation to Ulta’s skin-care assortment
stories.desc_en: Peach & Lily is betting that “zombie cells” can become beauty’s next mainstream science story with a $59 senolytic moisturizer launching across more than 1,500 Ulta Beauty stores.
stories.desc_zh: Peach & Lily押注“僵尸细胞”可以成为美容的下一个主流科学故事，在1,500多家Ulta Beauty商店推出$ 59的抗衰老保湿霜。

stories.title_en: OpenAI reportedly completed a $7 billion employee tender offer
stories.desc_en: San Francisco's housing market is in trouble again.
stories.desc_zh: 旧金山的房地产市场再次陷入困境。

stories.title_en: As AI-led attacks multiply, OpenAI launches a new cyber model
stories.desc_en: OpenAI is expanding its AI cybersecurity defense program Daybreak, and rolling out a new cyber-trained AI model with it.
stories.desc_zh: OpenAI正在扩展其人工智能网络安全防御计划Daybreak ，并推出一种新的网络训练人工智能模型。

stories.title_en: Mark Zuckerberg’s AI manifesto is exactly why people don’t like AI
stories.desc_en: On Monday, Mark Zuckerberg published a 6,500-word manifesto about personal AI, largely about the possibilities for the "personal superintelligence" systems Meta AI is building.
stories.desc_zh: 周一，马克·扎克伯格（ Mark Zuckerberg ）发表了一篇6500字的关于个人人工智能的宣言，主要是关于Meta AI正在构建的“个人超级智能”系统的可能性。

stories.title_en: Tech industry is buzzing after a Claude agent hacked into a gym
stories.desc_en: An OpenClaw agent hacked into a gym's reservation system to bump its human boss higher on a class' waitlist. And the tech industry took notice.
stories.desc_zh: 一名OpenClaw特工入侵了健身房的预订系统，将其人类老板列入班级候补名单。科技行业也注意到了这一点。

stories.title_en: Meta’s new Glimmer AI model offers a hint at Zuckerberg’s personal intelligence vision
stories.desc_en: Meta’s new open-weight Muse Glimmer model offers a glimpse of Mark Zuckerberg’s personal superintelligence vision, as well as  the emerging divide between AI users can own and access.
stories.desc_zh: Meta新的开放式Muse Glimmer模型提供了Mark Zuckerberg的个人超级智能愿景，以及AI用户可以拥有和访问之间正在出现的鸿沟。

stories.title_en: Discovered Materials is playing AI whack-a-mole to hunt cooler chips
stories.desc_en: Discovered Materials raised $9 million to fund the hunt for more novel materials to build more efficient chips.
stories.desc_zh: Discovered Materials筹集了900万$ ，用于寻找更新颖的材料，以制造更高效的芯片。

stories.title_en: Embattled hedge fund Situational Awareness invests $400M in chip startup Source Foundry
stories.desc_en: The AI-focused hedge fund is still making some big bets.
stories.desc_zh: 这家专注于人工智能的对冲基金仍在进行一些大赌注。

stories.title_en: Anthropic is turning Claude Code’s auto mode on by default
stories.desc_en: Programming with Claude Code will soon require even less human oversight.
stories.desc_zh: 使用Claude Code编程很快将需要更少的人工监督。

stories.title_en: Historian Jill Lepore says Silicon Valley misreads science fiction and undermines democracy
stories.desc_en: On the latest episode of Equity, we spoke to Jill Lepore about "government by machines" and why Elon Musk is a bad science fiction reader.
stories.desc_zh: 在最新一期的《Equity》中，我们采访了吉尔·勒波雷（ Jill Lepore ） ，谈到了“机器政府”以及为什么埃隆·马斯克（ Elon Musk ）是一个糟糕的科幻小说读者。

stories.title_en: The AI safety test is becoming a safety risk
stories.desc_en: AI agents are escaping cybersecurity testing environments and reaching real-world systems, raising questions about whether safety infrastructure, industry standards, and regulation can keep pace with increasingly powerful models.
stories.desc_zh: 人工智能代理正在逃避网络安全测试环境，进入现实世界的系统，这引发了人们对安全基础设施、行业标准和监管能否跟上日益强大的模型的质疑。

stories.title_en: Planned Amazon data center could become the biggest climate polluter in the US
stories.desc_en: AI has already had a significant impact on Amazon’s carbon emissions, which it reported were up 16% last year — the wrong direction for a company that pledged to eliminate its carbon emissions by 2040.
stories.desc_zh: 人工智能已经对亚马逊的碳排放量产生了重大影响，据报道，去年亚马逊的碳排放量增长了16% ，这对于一家承诺到2040年消除碳排放的公司来说是一个错误的方向。

stories.title_en: OpenAI acquires presentation startup NextSlide
stories.desc_en: Founder Ahmed Beshry describes the startup’s product as one “that could turn prompts, notes, documents, or research into a polished, editable presentation.”
stories.desc_zh: 创始人艾哈迈德·贝什里（ Ahmed Beshry ）将这家初创公司的产品描述为“可以将提示、笔记、文档或研究转化为精美、可编辑的演示文稿的产品”。

stories.title_en: OpenAI says it slowed Astra model development over security concerns
stories.desc_en: OpenAI said this model, which is still in development, reached its "critical cybersecurity threshold," meaning it could independently identify and carry out cyberattacks against traditionally well-protected real-world systems.
stories.desc_zh: OpenAI表示，该模型仍在开发中，已达到“关键网络安全阈值” ，这意味着它可以独立识别并针对传统上受到良好保护的现实世界系统进行网络攻击。

stories.title_en: After Rippling blew millions on AI in months, it built an employee ROI tool
stories.desc_en: After its own AI usage wake-up call, Rippling this week unveiled AI Spend Console, a product that tracks individual and team employee AI spending.

stories.title_en: Cloudflare launches Kitesurf, a browser built for AI agents
stories.desc_en: Kitesurf is a cloud-hosted browser designed for AI agents instead of people. It uses less computing power than Chromium for common automation tasks, helping developers build browser-based AI agents more efficiently.
stories.desc_zh: Kitesurf是一款云托管浏览器，专为人工智能代理而非人工智能代理而设计。与Chromium相比，它在常见自动化任务上的计算能力更低，可帮助开发人员更高效地构建基于浏览器的人工智能代理。
